newsitem.title: USA: BDM Int'l sees Q2 EPS of $0.14 to $0.16.
newsitem.headline: BDM Int'l sees Q2 EPS of $0.14 to $0.16.

text.p: BDM International Inc said Monday it expects earnings and revenue for the second quarter ending June 30 to be below expectations and also expects earnings in the third and fourth quarters to be hurt.
The company said it expects second quarter earnings to be about $0.14 to $0.16 a share, which it said is below the Wall Street analysts' consensus estimate of $0.25 per share.
Additionally, it said problems with a state government contract could impact earnings by an additional $0.04 to $0.06 per share in each of the third and fourth quarters.
Revenue for the second quarter should be in the range of $275 million to $280 million, compared to $252 million in the second quarter 1996, it said.
It attributed its revised forecast to a delivery delay on a hardware contract, the unfavorable impact of foreign exchange translations, and issues involving the state government contract."

It also said a hardware purchase of about $15 million expected in the second quarter will slip to the third quarter, and that strength of the U.S. dollar will cut revenue from its German operations by $3 million to $5 million for the quarter.
It said it recorded an impact of $2.8 million in prior quarters and will not book revenue or profit in the second quarter related to the state contract.
The company said it plans to incur costs on the contract without recognizing revenue until an understanding has been reached with its customer.
BDM is a Fortune 1000 multinational information technology company.
